Name: Less Mini Shipping Bin
Author: Atravita
TagLine: Lets you set the capacity of the mini shipping bin higher. (Also jumino chests, chests in general, and fridges, by popular demand...)
Description:
Lets you set the capacity of the mini shipping bin higher. (Up to <s>48</s> 120 whole slots!) Also lets you set the capacity of the jumino chests higher, as well as small chests, big chests, and fridges. All separately.

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.

*   Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. In multiplayer, probably best if everyone installs the mod.
See also

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/LessMiniShippingBin/LessMiniShippingBin/docs/changelog.md)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/LessMiniShippingBin/LessMiniShippingBin)

Requires SMAPI, uses Harmony.

All donation points for this mod go to [Against Malaria](https://www.againstmalaria.com/). Please consider supporting them if you like this mod!
Looking for something else? Please consider [my other mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/116553368?tab=user+files)!
